law_name: Law of the Republic of Belarus No. 262-Z of 17 May 2011 on Copyright and Related Rights
term_of_protection: Author's life + 70 years (extended from life + 50 years on 19 November 2024; works already in the public domain are not restored)
moral_rights: Authorship, name, integrity, disclosure & recall (no time limit)
digital_protection: Art. 4 defines (effective) technical means and RMI; copies made by circumventing TPM or removing RMI are counterfeit (article no. unverified) (unconfirmed)
fair_use_exceptions: Closed list: personal copying (arts. 18), free uses (art. 19), library/teaching reprography (art. 20) (unconfirmed)

changes.from: WCT party: anti-circumvention protection required by WCT art. 11 (national rule not checked)
